title: Embedding a machine configuration
statement: Given an amplified configuration $D$, a run index $j\in\text{Fin}(r+1)$, a counter $c\in\text{Fin}(r+2)$, and a configuration $u$ of $N$ on input $x$, the resulting amplified configuration has the same input-head position as $u$ and empty output. On work tapes belonging to run $j$, it copies the tape contents and head positions from $u$; on all other work tapes, it preserves those of $D$. Its phase state records the state of $u$ and the summary of its output when $u$ has not halted, and records a rewind phase with the counter adjusted according to whether that summary is true when $u$ has halted.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include definitions of the output-summary, counter-adjustment, or tape-block indexing operations, so their meanings cannot be stated more explicitly from the given material.
